title: Hydrodynamics of Nonminimal $F^{(a)αβ} F^{(a)γλ} R_{αγ} R_{βλ}$ AdS Black Brane
summary: We investigate the hydrodynamic properties of a strongly coupled non-Abelian plasma dual to a four-dimensional AdS black brane with a nonminimal coupling of the form $q_2 F^{(a)αβ}F^{(a)γλ}R_{αγ}R_{βλ}$ in the bulk action. This higher-derivative term introduces a direct interaction between the Yang-Mills field strength and the Ricci tensor, leading to corrections beyond the minimal Einstein-Yang-Mills theory.
